import json

transcript_path = "/Users/huncho/.gemini/antigravity-ide/brain/80c2d294-d8d4-46e4-bb1b-160fa56b5bdc/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl"

out_idx = 0
with open(transcript_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for i, line in enumerate(f):
        if "browser_get_dom" in line and "betting__container" in line:
            with open(f"dom_match_{out_idx}.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
                out.write(line)
            print(f"Found match on line {i}, wrote to dom_match_{out_idx}.json")
            out_idx += 1
